The plate spans about 360 px in the image. I'm assuming a dinner plate of about 26 cm, though it could be closer to 20 cm. The food pile is about 210 px wide, which works out to roughly 15 cm on a 26 cm plate, or about 12 cm on a 20 cm plate. I'll take a middle value of about 13 cm.

The pile looks like crispy shredded hash browns topped with fresh pico de gallo (tomato, red onion) and green salsa. I'd guess it is about 3-4 cm high, so the volume is roughly 300 cm³ with air gaps. That gives roughly:
- Hash browns: about 110 g, at roughly 190 kcal per 100 g because they are fried.
- Pico de gallo (tomato and onion): about 60 g, at about 25 kcal per 100 g.
- Green salsa (salsa verde): about 25 g, at about 30 kcal per 100 g.
